synthesis.climate_context: Insufficient local data — recommend manual research
synthesis.building_stock: The only Port Melbourne-specific door record returned is a Bay Street apartment whose entry door "cannot be locked from the inside as there is just a turn knob" (Airtasker, Port Melbourne VIC lock-installation page), and Corporate Locksmiths services the suburb off CBD-dispatched vehicles rather than as an outer-suburban run (corplock.com.au/pages/locksmith-port-melbourne) — so the local job mix evidenced here is apartment entry doors with existing thumbturn-only interior hardware, where the retrofit has to work with what is already on the door rather than a standard house front-door swap.
synthesis.council_notes: None identified — no returned record mentions a heritage overlay, owners-corporation or body-corporate rules on common entrances, or rental-provider obligations; the one apartment record (Bay St, Airtasker) concerns that unit's own entry door, not common property.
synthesis.demographic_skew: The only resident-level demand signal returned for Port Melbourne itself is a carer arranging a smart lock for a person with Alzheimer's who wanders and had just relocated to a Bay Street apartment (Airtasker Port Melbourne), pointing to care- and accessibility-driven apartment retrofits rather than owner-occupier convenience upgrades; no broader demographic data was returned for the suburb.
common_concerns: Whether a smart lock can be fitted at all to an apartment entry door that currently has only an interior turn knob and cannot be locked from the inside (Airtasker Port Melbourne — Bay St apartment).
Using the lock to keep a vulnerable resident safely inside while still allowing carers to get in — the wander-risk case raised in the Port Melbourne request (Airtasker Port Melbourne).

Whether the physical install is done carefully on an existing door — door prep, drilling, mounting and app setup — rather than just supplying hardware (Airtasker Port Melbourne review "Perfect, careful and thoughtful installation of smart lock. Great communication and great outcome."; amberpro.com.au smart-lock-installation-melbourne lists door prep, drilling, mounting and app setup as the full job).

Which lock format and brand actually suits the door — competitors in the returned set pitch smart keypads, lever locks, slim locks and smart deadbolts (corplock.com.au/pages/smart-lock-installation-melbourne) and brand lists spanning Yale, August, Schlage, Kwikset (amberpro.com.au) and Klug, Kaadas, Aqara, Ezviz, Moorgen (smartlockinstallation.com.au), leaving format choice as the open question on a thumbturn-only door.
